module: Solid triangle drawing for the spline editing tools (from the old render.lua). Triangles filtered at 600 m from the camera, filling of simple polygons (ear clipping triangulation) and filling of 2D regions with holes by scanline (even-odd rule). Used for surface previews in the editor.
notes: drawTriCulled only draws if all three vertices are within 600 m of the camera; the triangle is drawn solid with debugDraw.drawTriSolid.
drawFilledRegions2D is intended for previews, not final geometry: the staircase effect due to the scan step on diagonal edges is hidden by the exact outline drawn by the caller.

drawTriCulled.desc: Draws a solid triangle of color col if it is entirely within 600 m of the camera.

drawFilledPolygon.desc: Fills a simple polygon, possibly concave, whose vertices are vec3s already at the drawing height. Triangulates in 2D (x,y) by ear clipping (geom.triangulatePolygon2D), then draws the triangles. No effect for fewer than 3 vertices or a degenerate ring.

drawFilledRegions2D.desc: Fills a set of 2D regions ({x=,y=} rings), holes included, by horizontal scan with the even-odd rule: a point inside an odd number of rings is filled. Handles concave shapes and disjoint regions without triangulation.

regions.desc: List of rings, each a list of {x=,y=}.

zFn.desc: zFn(x, y) returns the drawing height (e.g. terrain height).

step.desc: Scan step; auto between 0.25 and 3 m (height/100) if nil.
